portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure that all previously-released
errata relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via Red Hat Network.  Details on how to use
the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
http://kbase.redhat.com/faq/FAQ_58_10188
portal_description:
xorg-x11-drv-sis is a Silicon Integrated Systems (SiS) graphics chipset
video driver for the X.Org implementation of the X Window System.

This updated package addresses the following bug:

* Some iterations of the 661, 741, 760 and 761 chipsets from SiS did not
work properly with the sis driver included with Red Hat Enterprise Linux
5.1. The chipsets were detected, but data sent to the attached displays was
garbled. Switching to the vesa driver worked around the problem and this
updated package includes configuration changes to automatically use the
vesa driver when these chipsets are detected.

On new installations of Red Hat Enterprise Linux 5.2, this updated package
will use the appropriate vesa driver automatically. On existing systems, it
may be necessary to switch to the vesa driver after the updated package is
installed. To do this, run the following command as root:

# system-config-display --reconfig

All users of the xorg-x11-drv-sis driver should upgrade to this updated
package, which resolves this issue.
